verdict.rationale: Okta is a SaaS identity platform that processes customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-usage policy is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training or any opt-out control. The MCP server, Cross App Access, SSO, SCIM and event hooks material, and the community comments about breaches and support files, are not about training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
